Cash Payment Voucher will cover all your transactions which are covered in cash and whether it is for a single unit or multi unit, everything will be at your finger tips.
For all your general transactions, there is an option of Journal Voucher.
We believe that your work is really important and it should be kept safe, so that’s why this software has Daily Account Closing option so that you can view your data at any time.
Also Data Backup will make sure that all your information stays safe if any disastrous condition occur.

This is a very important feature in a shift wise business because it will give you the leverage to assign an authority to the specific person who is working on that particular time shift. There is an Administration option that would have the rights to allocate certain controls to his employees. With the option of Multiple Accounts, you don’t have to worry about how many people are working there because with every individual account, every person will only focus on what he is responsible for.

title: Pharmacy
description: A Comprehensive solution to manage Medical Laboratories/Diagnostic Centers inside hospitals or working privately or independently.Available in very attractive price according to your Lab Needs.

blocks.text: Highly User Friendly Easy to Operate:
Easy to use screens enabling fast processing of Customer Orders, hence reducing timeline serving clients and increasing efficiency and proper record management.

System is already equipped and coded with unique data base of more than 17000 medicines, enable a hassle free implementation right after system installation. Moreover, more medicines can be added/deleted as per ease of users.
Powerful Search Feature with Generic Names:
Quick search enabled on Sales Man Screen to search from pool of medicine the product demanded along with alternatives and their price ranges.
Manage Batch wise Purchase and Sale Stock near to Expiry First by systematic management.
Sales man quickly punches the Required Daily Dose and number of days, system immediately calculates quantity needed. Hence, allowing a very fast mechanism of Customer Order Processing.
Multiple Order Processing in Single Time:
Multiple Users on Multiple Computers can input Multiple Customer Orders linked with Cash Counters. This will enable fast dealing of many clients in a single go.
Strong, Reliable and Controlled Billing Feature:

This feature enable Pharmacists to only punch Customer Order, Cash is only collected at Cash Counters. Also Sales Return is recorded at Cash Counter adjusting Customer Bill Amount Automatically as well as recording changes in Inventory.
Auto Purchase Order Based on Sales Forecast:
System will intelligently identify Sales of particular item and generate Auto Purchase Order based on minimum Shelf Quantity for that item with Auto Alerts of Minimum Level of Stock.
In case any particular stock ended, system quickly generates Local Purchase Receipt for quick and timely processing of customers order and also generate payable against that.
Track Record of inventory in Rack and Store:
Systematic control over stock in Racks and also in Store enabling smooth pharmacy operations.
Sale Base Item - Tracking and Reports:
A very unique feature with complete backend integrated working on Sale Base Items by vendors. Such items are only entered into Stock, but, a payable is auto generated as and when they are sold.

Payroll Module in Edu Pharma Manager Product enables to record all employee transactions such as Employee Advances, Loans, even if some medicine is taken by Employee, an auto Advance Entry is recorded against that Sale.
All Pharmacy Operations having Financial Impact are auto integrated systematically to generate Vouchers and Post them as and when event happens.
